name: hybrowse/hytale-server
description: Official Basalt Hytale server template, powered by the Hybrowse production Docker image with auto-download, CurseForge mod management, and backups.
author: Basalt Team

categories.label: General
categories.description: Core provisioning settings for the Hytale server.

children.label: Auto-Download Server Files
children.description: Automatically download Assets.zip and the Hytale server files via the official Hytale Downloader when they are missing. On first start this requires a one-time interactive device-code authentication, watch the server logs for a URL and code.

children.label: Auto-Update Server Files
children.description: Check for server updates on every start by comparing the remote version against the locally installed version. Downloads only happen when an update is available.

children.label: Downloader Patchline
children.description: Optional downloader patchline, for example to opt into a pre-release channel. Leave empty for the default patchline.

children.label: Skip Downloader Update Check
children.description: Passes -skip-update-check to the downloader to reduce network calls/variability during automation.

children.label: Time Zone
children.description: The time zone to use for the server.

categories.label: Server
categories.description: Convenience overrides applied to the server's config.json on every startup.

children.label: Server Name
children.description: Sets ServerName in config.json.

children.label: MOTD
children.description: Sets MOTD in config.json, displayed in the server list.

children.label: Server Password
children.description: Sets Password in config.json. Leave empty for no password.

children.label: Max Players
children.description: Sets MaxPlayers in config.json.

children.label: Max View Radius
children.description: Sets MaxViewRadius (chunks) in config.json.

children.label: Default World
children.description: Sets Defaults.World in config.json.

children.label: Default Game Mode
children.description: Sets Defaults.GameMode in config.json.

children.label: Allow Operator Command
children.description: If enabled, allows the /op self command on the server.

children.label: Singleplayer Mode
children.description: Starts the server in singleplayer mode.

children.label: Bare Mode
children.description: Starts the server with a bare/minimal configuration.

children.label: Advanced Config Patch (JSON)
children.description: A JSON object merged recursively into config.json on every startup. Existing keys not mentioned are preserved. Invalid JSON fails startup.

categories.label: Networking
categories.description: Hytale uses QUIC over UDP, not TCP. Make sure port 5520/udp is published.

children.label: Bind Address
children.description: Bind address for the QUIC/UDP listener.

children.label: Authentication Mode
children.description: Controls how players authenticate with the server.

children.label: Force Network Flush
children.description: Forces network buffers to be flushed more aggressively, trading a little throughput for lower latency.

children.label: Transport Override
children.description: Advanced: overrides the network transport implementation used by the server.

categories.label: CurseForge Mods
categories.description: Automatic mod download and updates from CurseForge. Requires a CurseForge API key from console.curseforge.com (keys start with $2a$10$).

children.label: CurseForge Mods
children.description: A list of CurseForge mod references. Use a project ID (123456) for the latest file, projectId:fileId (123456:3456789) to pin a specific file, or projectId@keyword to match a file by name.

children.label: CurseForge API Key
children.description: Required when CurseForge mods are configured. Generate one at console.curseforge.com.

children.label: Auto-Update Mods
children.description: Checks for mod updates on every startup and downloads only when needed. If disabled, keeps the already installed version.

children.label: Release Channel
children.description: The CurseForge release channel to install mod files from.

children.label: Game Version Filter
children.description: Filters CurseForge files by game version. Leave empty to accept all versions.

children.label: Update Check Interval (seconds)
children.description: If greater than 0, skips remote update checks when the last check was recent. Reduces API usage on frequent restarts.

children.label: Prune Removed Mods
children.description: Removes previously installed CurseForge mods that are no longer listed above.

children.label: Fail Startup on Mod Error
children.description: Fails container startup when any configured mod cannot be resolved or installed.

children.label: Enable Install Lock
children.description: Prevents concurrent CurseForge mod installations into the same data volume. Only disable for advanced use cases.

children.label: Debug Logging
children.description: Prints additional diagnostics on CurseForge API and download failures. The API key is never printed.

categories.label: Backups
categories.description: The Hytale dedicated server's internal backup mechanism. Backup outputs should be treated as opaque artifacts.

children.label: Enable Backups
children.description: Enables the server's internal backup mechanism.

children.label: Backup Directory
children.description: Directory backups are written to. It is recommended to keep this on a separate volume from /data.

children.label: Backup Frequency (minutes)
children.description: How often, in minutes, the server creates a backup.

children.label: Max Backup Count
children.description: Maximum number of backups to keep before older ones are pruned.

children.label: Max Backup Archive Count
children.description: Advanced: maximum number of backup archives to keep, if different from the max backup count.

categories.label: Authentication
categories.description: Server authentication is required after startup before players can connect. By default this is done interactively via the console (/auth login device). These settings are for advanced, non-interactive fleet setups.

children.label: Enable Session Token Broker
children.description: Fetches server session/identity tokens from a Hytale Session Token Broker at startup, skipping the interactive /auth flow. Intended for providers and fleets running their own broker.

children.label: Broker URL
children.description: Base URL of the Session Token Broker.

children.label: Broker Bearer Token
children.description: Optional HTTP bearer token used to authenticate against the broker API.

children.label: Broker Account
children.description: Optional broker account name used for minting tokens.

children.label: Broker Timeout (seconds)
children.description: Request timeout for the broker HTTP call.

children.label: Fail Startup on Broker Error
children.description: Fails container startup when the broker request fails. If disabled, the server continues without broker tokens.

children.label: Broker Min Retry Interval (seconds)
children.description: Minimum time between successful broker token fetches, to reduce token minting during crash/restart loops.

children.label: Manual Session Token
children.description: Advanced: manually supplied session token, used instead of the interactive /auth flow or the Session Token Broker.

children.label: Manual Identity Token
children.description: Advanced: manually supplied identity token, used instead of the interactive /auth flow or the Session Token Broker.

categories.label: Performance (JVM)
categories.description: The Hytale server requires Java 25 (this image ships Eclipse Temurin 25). Tune JVM heap and AOT cache behavior here.

children.label: JVM Initial Heap (Xms)
children.description: Initial JVM heap size, e.g. 2G. Leave empty to let the JVM pick a default based on available memory.

children.label: JVM Max Heap (Xmx)
children.description: Maximum JVM heap size, e.g. 4G. Setting an explicit value is recommended for predictable production operation.

children.label: Extra JVM Arguments
children.description: Extra JVM arguments appended to the java command.

children.label: AOT Cache
children.description: Controls use of the Java AOT cache for faster startup. "auto" enables it only when a compatible cache file exists.

children.label: Extra Server Arguments
children.description: Extra Hytale server arguments appended at the end of the command.

categories.label: Advanced
categories.description: Advanced and diagnostic settings for the Hytale server.

children.label: Machine ID
children.description: 32-character hex string used as the container's machine ID (used to encrypt stored auth credentials). Auto-generated and persisted if not set.

children.label: Disable Sentry
children.description: Disables error reporting to the Hytale team. Recommended during active plugin development.

children.label: Accept Early Plugins
children.description: Acknowledges that loading early plugins is unsupported and may cause stability issues.

children.label: Early Plugins Path
children.description: Path to early plugins to load.

children.label: Mods Path Override
children.description: Overrides the mods directory passed to the server. Leave empty to use the default (or the CurseForge-managed directory when mods are configured).

children.label: Owner Name
children.description: Sets the server owner name.

children.label: Owner UUID
children.description: Sets the server owner UUID.

children.label: Universe Path Override
children.description: Overrides the universe (world/player save data) directory passed to the server.

children.label: World Gen Path
children.description: Path to custom world generation data.

children.label: Prefab Cache Path
children.description: Path to the prefab cache.

children.label: Boot Command
children.description: A command executed on server boot.

children.label: Log Level/Target
children.description: Advanced logging configuration passed to the server.

children.label: Disable Asset Compare
children.description: Skips comparing local assets against expected checksums on startup.

children.label: Disable CPB Build
children.description: Disables building the compiled prefab bundle on startup.

children.label: Disable File Watcher
children.description: Disables the server's internal file watcher.

children.label: Event Debug Logging
children.description: Enables verbose event debug logging.

children.label: Validate Assets
children.description: Validates assets on startup.

children.label: Validate Prefabs
children.description: Set to "true" to validate prefabs on startup, or provide a specific value to pass through.

children.label: Validate World Gen
children.description: Validates world generation on startup.

children.label: Shutdown After Validate
children.description: Shuts the server down automatically after any enabled validation steps complete.

children.label: Enable Config Interpolation
children.description: Replaces ${CFG_*} / $CFG_* placeholders in JSON config files at startup using CFG_ environment variables.

children.label: Interpolation Scope
children.description: server-only interpolates only config.json. all also interpolates mod config JSON files. explicit interpolates config.json plus the paths you list separately.
